Name: USA and Canadian flag
Author: NeverPlayPubg
Description:
[u]Features:[/u]
-This mod allows you to change the 'Calico falls' painting to a USA/Canadian flag, you choose between them by editing the config file.

[u]Installation guide:[/u]
-Simply unzip this file to your mods folder.

[u]Future updates:
[/u]-There will be more flag variations as well as new changeable items.

[u]Hope you enjoy
[/u][img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/b/ba/Pufferfish.png[/img]
